signal.title: Develop Humanoid Robot Policies End-to-End with NVIDIA Isaac GR00T
signal.summary: 这项研究围绕视觉—语言—动作模型展开，关注机器人如何把视觉观察和语言指令，持续转换成跨时间的动作，而不是只对当前画面做一次反应。

editorial.intro: 这项研究围绕视觉—语言—动作模型展开，关注机器人如何把视觉观察和语言指令，持续转换成跨时间的动作，而不是只对当前画面做一次反应。
editorial.why_it_matters: VLA 的记忆、推理和实时执行能力，直接决定具身智能能否从演示动作走向长时任务和真实部署。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对实验是否覆盖真实机器人、长时任务和跨场景泛化。

evidence.title: Develop Humanoid Robot Policies End-to-End with NVIDIA Isaac GR00T
evidence.excerpt: Robotics English 中文 Develop Humanoid Robot Policies End-to-End with NVIDIA Isaac GR00T Jul 07, 2026 By Edith Llontop and Brandon Neel Discuss (1) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary The NVIDIA Isaac GR00T Development Platform unifies every stage of the humanoid robot pipeline, from data collection and model training to large-scale evaluation and deployment readiness. GR00T 1.7 is the first open, commercially usable vision-language-action model for generalized humanoid skills, released under the Apache 2.0 license with a 3-billion-parameter base checkpoint. The model introduces a Cosmos-Reason2-2B (Qwen3-VL architecture) backbone, robust pretraining on ~32K hours of real and ~8K hours of simulated data, and full ONNX and TensorRT export support. Benchmarks show consistent improvements over N1.6, including DROID-F0 (+10%), DROID-F6 (+61%), SimplerEnv Bridge (+5%), and Fractal (+2%). An end-to-end simulation workflow demonstrates environment setup with Isaac Lab-Arena, demonstration collection via Isaac Teleop and CloudXR, LeRobot format conversion, post-training with frozen language model, and closed-loop policy evaluation.
